cuts.item: middle school sports and student-athlete transportation, reinstated via athletic department supplement

statements.statement: Article 1, submitted by the school department, seeks to raise and appropriate an additional sum for the FY27 school operating budget; board voted to include it in the warrant
Article 2, a citizens' petition, seeks to raise/appropriate or transfer from available funds a sum to supplement the FY27 school operating budget; no dollar figure stated

Article 3, a citizens' petition, seeks to transfer this amount from certified free cash or available funds to the FY27 school operating budget to reinstate middle school sports and athlete transportation; board voted to approve the warrant with this article included
In discussing whether article two duplicates article one, a member remarked they don't think the town will 'put' this amount

Town manager clarified there is currently no certified free cash available, and it is nearly impossible that certified free cash will exist by the September 3rd special town meeting; free cash is certified as of June 30 and the process hadn't concluded
